ibl: Filament-style GGX split sum; s6=512x256 RGBM64 octahedral roughness atlas (4x2 tiles, 128 stride, 2 padding), s7=128x128 RG/BA packed 16-bit DFG A/B
shadow: 2x4 point-filter RGBA8 atlas: near/far columns; ordinary opaque, water, first sky entrance, interior opaque rows. RG is 16-bit little-endian depth. Water BA is red/blue sunlight /4. Shadow c0=forward/inverse range, c1=origin/cutoff, c2=clip enable/inverse sky width/inverse sky height/interior row pixel offset; s1=separate 2x1 sky entrance depth. Single entrance per light ray; v1-v4 keep their 2x2 atlas.
normal: RGB tangent-space XYZ UNORM; +Y follows increasing texture V; A scales dielectric F0 = 0.04*A (metals use albedo F0)
cornerAtlas: s1=square 16384/8192/4096 point-filter RGBA8; four corner rows plus one RGBA AO row per group; COLOR0 retains bank-local corner addresses; c0.z=bank+64*(16384/atlasSize-1), each bank contains 1048576 quads
orm: RGBA UNORM = occlusion, perceptual roughness, signed material byte (128 dielectric, 255 metal, 1 thin transmission), emissive albedo scale
colorPolicy: sRGB albedo/lightmap reads; linear data maps and corner bytes; linear BRDF and tone mapping; sRGB output
geometryPolicy: geometric normals from world-position derivatives; no NORMAL input or geometry rebuild
dynamicLights: Local GGX light draw after affected terrain/block-entity/water meshes. s2=64x1 point-filter RGBA8, five texels per light, at most eight. c0=inverseBlockSize,0,cornerLayout,count; cornerLayout=bank+64*(16384/atlasSize-1); c1=render-space eye/exposure. Water uses the identical c15..18 wave/optics constants. Depth test without writes, additive RGB preserving destination alpha.

water.vertexColor: R/G=block/sky times 16, B=0..16 block water depth, A=shore weight; waves are independent of sprite UVs
water.normal: s3=256x256 repeating XYZ normal, A=foam noise, smooth mipmapped linear data; PNG import requires noclamp
water.transform: invviewprojmat transports wrapped chunk phase/inverse block size, motion, scattering/foam, absorption/reflection
water.passes: current-view scene copy followed by one translucent colour draw per fluid batch; depth test without depth write

waterSSR.depth: GMod SSAO DepthWrite COLOR_DEPTH: linear perspective clip W / 4000 in red; engine scene depth redraw plus MC alpha-tested depth draws
waterSSR.trace: half-resolution RGBA16F: hit UV, receiver view depth in Source units, confidence; up to 48 deterministic steps and five binary refinements
waterSSR.composition: four receiver-depth-aware point taps replace only environmental reflection; pre-water colour source prevents feedback; main-view colour/depth generation must match
